Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.delivery

Class NotebookLMResearchExportAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.delivery.NotebookLMResearchExportAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResearchExportPort
@Component public class NotebookLMResearchExportAdapter extends Object implements ResearchExportPort
ResearchExportPort adapter that delegates to NotebookLMService.

Called by ResearchOrchestratorService after each successful STAGED_RESEARCH run to export Perplexity-sourced articles to the NotebookLM on-disk corpus.

As mandated by the ResearchExportPort contract, IOExceptions are caught and logged rather than propagated — a failed export must never abort the research response returned to the caller.

  • Method Details

    • export

      public void export(String label, List<NewsArticle> articles)
      Exports the given articles under the specified label.

      Delegates to NotebookLMService.export(java.lang.String, java.util.List<com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.NewsArticle>). Any IOException is caught, logged as a warning, and swallowed so that the research response is never blocked by a filesystem failure.

      Specified by:
      export in interface ResearchExportPort
      Parameters:
      label - human-readable title for the export (e.g. "Research: AI diagnostics")
      articles - articles to export; may be empty (no-op in that case)
